sub_elements.applicability_evidence: distribution_formats populated with four Dataverse access_urls and the Data Access API; license CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 permits non-commercial reuse; third_party_sharing.is_shared=true
sub_elements.evidence: related_datasets: is_previous_version_of (10.18130/V3/DXWOS5), is_described_by (two preprint DOIs)
sub_elements.quality_note: Typed relationships with DOIs; the U2OS Nature deposits are kept in external_resources rather than typed as related datasets, which is defensible.

strengths: Identification and access are complete: Dataverse DOIs for every release, per-file md5/size/MIME inventory, access URLs and API route, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with named copyright holders
Referent discipline: the U2OS Nature cell map is held out as a related publication with its own deposits rather than absorbed into composition, collection or funding
Full motivation and funding block with two well-formed NIH award numbers, RePORTER details, and six creator groups with ORCIDs and credit roles
Versioning, errata, quarterly cadence and provenance (laboratory archives, external deposits, FAIRSCAPE/EVI graphs) are anchored to specific releases
Human-subjects, de-identification and regulatory fields are mutually consistent for a cell-line dataset, and source conflicts are surfaced in caveats with the priority rule stated
weaknesses: No variable-level metadata or is_tabular flag for any data stream
No sampling, missingness, anomaly or sensitive-content documentation
Top-level doi and version slots are empty; the identifiers live only in resources, citation and version_access
Distribution formats stop at the ZIP container and metadata exports; internal file formats are unstated
external_resources mixes bare repository names and accessions into a URI list, and publisher is a bare ROR id
recommendations: Populate top-level doi and version from the June 2026 release (10.18130/V3/HIGT4C, V2)
Add variables (from the release RO-Crate JSON-Schemas) and is_tabular per data stream
Add sampling_strategies, missing_data_documentation, anomalies and a sensitive_elements statement (even if negative)
State the file formats inside each ZIP archive (image, MS search output, count matrix formats) and encoding
Resolve MassIVE/ProteomeXchange/Figshare/BioProject accessions to URLs and add the publisher name beside the ROR id
